description: Shared by the CLI approver and the web approver: both must decide raw/argv divergence the same way and reconstruct the same command line. Each case gives a wire syntactic substrate, whether raw and the hash-bound bin/argv describe different commands, and the command line bin/argv reconstruct to (null when there is no command form). Expected values are written by hand from the rules in packages/approver/src/lib/render.ts and packages/web-approver/src/command-line.ts: bin is prepended unless argv starts with it; with no argv, bin and positionals are used; a token is single-quoted when it is empty or contains whitespace, a quote, a backslash or one of $`&|;<>(){}[]*?#~!.

cases.name: bin is prepended when argv omits it
bin is not repeated when argv starts with it

double-quoted raw counts as divergent (fails safe)

an empty token is shown as ''
